title: Where can I find school tileset s?

posts.author: lilithisia
posts.body: Hi, I'm new to RMMV and I just downloaded it today. I also bought the full bundle of Yanfly's plugins for MV, but I find it really hard to understand how the whole programming world works yet. I was wondering if anyone could help me find some scholastic tilesets on the internet, or tell me how I can change my tilesets.Also, is there a specific order to install yanfly's plugins? If there is, how should I install them? Thank you

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body:
The order of Yanfly plugins is listed on their website
Category:Yanfly Engine Plugins - Yanfly.moe Wiki
www.yanfly.moe

posts.body:

the tilesets are defined in the database, more details on them are in the help files.
as for school tiles, you might find a few tiles in the resource section of this forum - but for complete tilesets you would have to go to this website's shop where several different tilesets for schools are available (like medieval, modern and fturistic schools)

posts.author: SeaPhoenix
posts.body:
This old post by Shaz tells you how to change the tileset and how to use them in a new map:
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/index.php?threads/how-to-add-custom-tilesets.70914/#post-672121
What kind of school tiles are you looking for specifically? The Sci-Fi Inside tileset that comes with RPG Maker MV has desks and chairs and a blackboard.
whtdragon made alchemy workshop tiles a while back (plus other great tiles as well), and you could probably use them for a science lab:
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/index.php?threads/merry-maker-christmas-2016.72675/

posts.author: Avery
posts.body:
Resource requests go in their own section, that is here:
Resource Requests
Request for resources for your game here. Make sure to read the rules before requesting!
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
And it will help you a lot to put in a lot more information into your post, describing what you image, what you plan, etc. There is a request form:
Rules - Resource Request Form
When making a new request thread, it would be helpful if you follow this form:  Resource Type: (Characters, Battlers, Tiles, Icons, ect.)  Maker Format: (2k,2k3,XP,VX,Ace,MV, MZ)  Makers I Own: (2k,2k3,XP,VX,Ace,MV, MZ)  Art Style: (Ace RTP, Mack, LPC, Cartoony, Realistic, Artist's original...
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
The simple rule is: the better your request is, the better the help you recieve
Don't expect the people to do guesswork or having to interview you to understand what you need, be clear and - if you are looking for free stuff - be willing to compromise.
